map.从网页、PDF、表格复制来的文本常常带着多余空行和首尾空格。粘贴进来，勾选需要的: Text copied from web pages, PDFs or spreadsheets often carries extra blank lines and leading/trailing spaces. Paste it in, tick the cleanups you need, and get tidy text instantly.
map.：行尾空格、连续空行、重复空格、制表符与不统一的换行符。: : trailing spaces, consecutive blank lines, repeated spaces, tabs and inconsistent line breaks.
map.：可删除全部空行，或把连续多个空格合并为一个。: : delete all blank lines, or merge consecutive spaces into one.
map.中的缩进具有语义，清理时需避免破坏。: have semantic indentation that cleanup must not break.
map.：整理文本与代码，减少版本对比中的无意义差异。: : tidy text and code, reducing meaningless diffs in version control.

map.清理为纯本地操作，文本不会上传；适合处理从网页/PDF/Excel 复制的乱序文: Cleanup is purely local; text is never uploaded, suited to messy text copied from web/PDF/Excel.
map.各选项可单独勾选；默认全部开启即可应付大多数场景。: Each option can be toggled individually; all on by default covers most cases.
map.合并空格仅针对空格与制表符，不影响换行。: Merging spaces targets spaces and tabs only, not line breaks.
map.处理从表格或网页粘贴来的文本：压缩多余空格与制表符，让内容在编辑器里排版正常。: Process text pasted from tables or web pages: compress excess spaces and tabs so it lays out normally in the editor.
map.`a b\\t\\n c` → `a b c`（多空白合并为单空格并去首尾）: `a   b\t\n c` → `a b c` (excess whitespace merged to single space and trimmed).
map.可选保留段落或全压成一行。: Optionally keep paragraphs or flatten everything to one line.
map.为什么清理后缩进没了？: Why did indentation disappear after cleaning?
map.因为行首空格（缩进）也属于空白字符：若选择了「压缩所有连续空白」或「删除行首尾空: Because leading spaces (indentation) are also whitespace: if you enabled "compress all consecutive whitespace" or "trim line edges", code indentation and list hierarchy are removed too. When handling code or structured text, compress only in-line repeated spaces and keep leading indentation; try a small snippet first, confirm, then apply to all.
